video.name: 4 Christian End Times Views Explained: Premillennial, Amillennial, Postmillennial
video.headline: Four Christian Views of the End Times, Side by Side
video.description: Christians agree Jesus is coming back but disagree about the thousand years of Revelation 20. This overview sets the four main evangelical views side by side: dispensational premillennialism, historic premillennialism, amillennialism and postmillennialism.
video.narrator: Narrated by Tom Daly, editor of Christian Curator

position-1.name: Will Jesus Reign Over Restored Israel for 1,000 Years? Dispensationalism Explained
position-1.description: Dispensational premillennialism holds that Jesus comes for his church first, then returns to reign for a thousand years over Israel restored to its land, as God promised. It is one of four Christian views of the end times.

position-2.name: Will Jesus Raise His People to Reign on Earth for 1,000 Years? Historic Premillennialism Explained
position-2.description: Historic premillennialism holds that the church endures the tribulation, then Christ returns, raises his people, and reigns on earth for a thousand years. It is one of four Christian views of the end times.

position-3.name: Are We Living in the 1,000 Years Right Now? Amillennialism Explained
position-3.description: Amillennialism holds that the thousand years of Revelation 20 is the church age: Satan is bound, Christ reigns now with his saints, and he returns once, at the end, with resurrection and judgment together. It is one of four Christian views of the end times.

position-4.name: Will the Gospel Fill the Earth Before Jesus Returns? Postmillennialism Explained
position-4.description: Postmillennialism holds that the thousand years is the gospel age still unfolding: the kingdom grows like a mustard seed until it fills the earth, and then Christ returns. It is one of four Christian views of the end times.
